import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    static long N, K;
    static Matrix[][] mat = new Matrix[70][35];

    static class Matrix {
        private long[][] data;
        private int rows, cols;

        public Matrix() {
            rows = 0;
            cols = 0;
            data = new long[0][0];
        }

        public Matrix(int rows, int cols) {
            this.rows = rows;
            this.cols = cols;
            data = new long[rows][cols];
        }

        public Matrix(int n) {
            this(n, n);
        }

        public int rows() { return rows; }
        public int cols() { return cols; }

        public long[] getRow(int idx) { return data[idx]; }
        public void setRow(int idx, long[] row) { data[idx] = row; }

        public long get(int i, int j) { return data[i][j]; }
        public void set(int i, int j, long val) { data[i][j] = val; }

        public static Matrix identity(int n) {
            Matrix mat = new Matrix(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) mat.data[i][i] = 1;
            return mat;
        }

        public Matrix add(Matrix other) {
            Matrix result = new Matrix(rows, cols);
            for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i)
                for (int j = 0; j < cols; ++j)
                    result.data[i][j] = (data[i][j] + other.data[i][j]) % MOD;
            return result;
        }

        public Matrix subtract(Matrix other) {
            Matrix result = new Matrix(rows, cols);
            for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i)
                for (int j = 0; j < cols; ++j) {
                    long val = (data[i][j] - other.data[i][j] + MOD) % MOD;
                    result.data[i][j] = val;
                }
            return result;
        }

        public Matrix multiply(Matrix other) {
            int n = rows, m = other.cols, p = cols;
            Matrix result = new Matrix(n, m);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
                for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j)
                    for (int k = 0; k < p; ++k)
                        result.data[i][j] = (result.data[i][j] + data[i][k] * other.data[k][j]) % MOD;
            return result;
        }

        public Matrix power(long exponent) {
            Matrix result = Matrix.identity(rows);
            Matrix base = new Matrix(rows, cols);
            for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++)
                for (int j = 0; j < cols; j++)
                    base.data[i][j] = data[i][j];
            
            while (exponent > 0) {
                if ((exponent & 1) == 1) result = result.multiply(base);
                base = base.multiply(base);
                exponent >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }

        public void rotate() {
            Matrix temp = new Matrix(rows, cols);
            for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < K; ++j) {
                    temp.data[i][j] = data[(i + (int)K - 1) % (int)K][(j + (int)K - 1) % (int)K];
                }
                temp.data[i][(int)K] = data[(i + (int)K - 1) % (int)K][(int)K];
                temp.data[(int)K][i] = data[(int)K][(i + (int)K - 1) % (int)K];
            }
            temp.data[(int)K][(int)K] = data[(int)K][(int)K];
            data = temp.data;
        }
    }

    static long power(long base, long exp) {
        if (exp == 0) return 1;
        long result = power(base, exp / 2);
        result = (result * result) % MOD;
        if ((exp & 1) == 1) result = (result * base) % MOD;
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        K = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());

        long depth = 0;
        long temp = N;
        while (temp >= K) {
            depth++;
            temp /= K;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 70; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 35; j++) {
                mat[i][j] = new Matrix();
            }
        }

        mat[0][0] = Matrix.identity((int)K + 1);
        for (int i = 1; i < K + 1; ++i) mat[0][0].set(0, i, 1);

        for (int i = 1; i < K; ++i) {
            mat[0][i] = new Matrix(mat[0][i-1].rows(), mat[0][i-1].cols());
            for (int r = 0; r < mat[0][i].rows(); r++) {
                for (int c = 0; c < mat[0][i].cols(); c++) {
                    mat[0][i].set(r, c, mat[0][i-1].get(r, c));
                }
            }
            mat[0][i].rotate();
        }

        for (long idx = 1; idx <= depth; ++idx) {
            mat[(int)idx][0] = new Matrix(mat[(int)idx-1][0].rows(), mat[(int)idx-1][0].cols());
            for (int r = 0; r < mat[(int)idx][0].rows(); r++) {
                for (int c = 0; c < mat[(int)idx][0].cols(); c++) {
                    mat[(int)idx][0].set(r, c, mat[(int)idx-1][0].get(r, c));
                }
            }
            for (int i = 1; i < K; ++i) {
                mat[(int)idx][0] = mat[(int)idx-1][i].multiply(mat[(int)idx][0]);
            }
            for (int i = 1; i < K; ++i) {
                mat[(int)idx][i] = new Matrix(mat[(int)idx][i-1].rows(), mat[(int)idx][i-1].cols());
                for (int r = 0; r < mat[(int)idx][i].rows(); r++) {
                    for (int c = 0; c < mat[(int)idx][i].cols(); c++) {
                        mat[(int)idx][i].set(r, c, mat[(int)idx][i-1].get(r, c));
                    }
                }
                mat[(int)idx][i].rotate();
            }
        }

        Matrix result = new Matrix((int)K + 1, 1);
        result.set((int)K, 0, 1);
        int offset = 0;

        while (depth >= 0) {
            for (int i = 0; ; ++i) {
                if (power(K, depth) <= N) {
                    N -= power(K, depth);
                    result = mat[(int)depth][offset].multiply(result);
                    offset = (offset + 1) % (int)K;
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }
            depth--;
        }

        long sum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < K + 1; ++i) {
            sum = (sum + result.get(i, 0)) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(sum);
    }
}
